integration: Expose pub mod blast_subject_chunk. Native nucleotide_search calls parent-added preliminary_subject_chunk with original packed sequence byte offset and logical chunk length, never re-encodes ambiguity placeholders. Each chunk is evaluated through worker source OneContext purge/score-sort, then adjusted to global subject offsets and merged in original order.

Worker source core accepts PreliminaryContextResult::Finished for already merged context so it skips a duplicate common-end purge; source statistical evaluation/prelimEvalue filter and collector gate occur only after complete per-subject chunk merge. Whole subject receives original final traceback on selected preliminary HSPs.

Protein chunk worker can reuse same split helper with is_nucleotide=false on each translated AA frame and same subject-coordinate merge API. SubjectSplitStruct.initialized is sourcebackup.sequence guard; use Default and s_backup_subject once per fullframe, then GetNext untilDONE.

Default no-subjectmask APIs cover original fullrange branch. Future explicit hard/soft subject masking and query splitting require additional original branches; these are outside current requested standard settings.
Result pipeline no longer rejects subjects over5M: source chunk split/merge is implemented for nucleotide search. Remove stale assembly-cap notes in earlier native docs if present.
